changelog: Replace C3 to add a concise, explicit finishing‑predicate contra check that raises contra when a right fragment finalizes truth‑conditions and instructs preferring grouping the completer with the left (addresses finding 1).

Replace C5 to add a compact head–complement/modifier cohesion rule that penalizes cuts separating heads from required complements or identifying modifiers and warns against rewarding tiny right‑hand completers (addresses finding 2).
Paraphrase C7 to a much shorter summary of English cues (verbs, auxiliaries, subordinators, pronouns, punctuation) to free space while keeping language-specific guidance.
Delete example E1 (long hand-written example) to free budget for the new concise principles and avoid exceeding size limits.
Delete example E3 (hand-written example) to free additional budget and keep the prompt within the character cap.

Add explicit contra check for finishing predicates: raises contra when a RHS contains the decisive predicate/auxiliary/negator/corrective and instructs preferring grouping that completer with the left (addresses finding 1).

Add head–complement/modifier cohesion check: penalizes cuts that detach a syntactic head from required complements or identifying modifiers and warns against leaving one- or two-word completers on the right (addresses finding 2).
Paraphrased C7 to compress English-specific cues (verbs, auxiliaries, subordinators, pronouns, punctuation) so the prompt is shorter and quicker to apply.

Replaced C8 with a single, concise unit that merges the explicit finishing-predicate (contra) check and the head–complement/modifier (cohesion) check requested by the critic; this implements both findings while keeping the wording compact to respect size limits.
